cells.gaps: Plan National du Numerique Horizon 2025 was validated at a 2019 workshop with no cabinet act on record, so adoption is not established. Its successors, the Politique sectorielle de l'economie numerique 2026-2030 (validated 4 Aug 2026, to go to the Council of Ministers; no action plan, steering body or monitoring yet) and the PNN2 2026-2030 (drafting or announced, costed, period 2026-2030), are not adopted. Reporting is a ministry estimate of 60% completion, not measured against targets. The two successors are not reconciled.
cells.note: Instrument: Plan National du Numerique Horizon 2025, whose period ended in 2025, with successor PSEN 2026-2030 validated but not adopted, so the cell is stage 2, lapsed. Stage 3 needs an adopted strategy inside its period.
